My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If the tracking indicates delivered but you have not received the package, please follow these steps:
Check around the delivery location
Inspect all entrances, porches, side doors, garage areas, mailbox area, or parcel lockers.
Ask household members, neighbors, building staff, or reception if they accepted the package.
Wait a short time and recheck tracking
Occasionally, carriers mark a package as delivered before it actually arrives. It may be delivered later that day or the following day.
Use your tracking link for carrier details
The tracking page may provide additional delivery notes, a photo, or the exact drop-off location.
The tracking link is typically included in the shipping confirmation email once the order has shipped.
Contact our customer service team if the package still has not arrived
